preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S has a length between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each character in the test case string S is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'WIN' or 'LOSE'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == 'WIN' if all(c == '1' for c in stdin.splitlines()[i+1]) else return_value[i] == 'LOSE' for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
postconditions.description: Chef wins if and only if all cards in the test case string S are initially face up ('1').
